mapper.sql: work_date >= CONCAT(#{targetMonth}, '-01') AND work_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{targetMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_record ( employee_id, work_date, check_in_time, check_out_time, status, tardy_reason, modify_reason, is_closed, overtime_hours, night_work_hours, holiday_work_hours, is_unpaid_leave ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{workDate}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{status}, #{tardyReason}, #{modifyReason}, COALESCE(#{closed}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{overtimeHours}, 0), COALESCE(#{nightWorkHours}, 0), COALESCE(#{holidayWorkHours}, 0), COALESCE(#{unpaidLeave}, FALSE) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE check_in_time = VALUES(check_in_time), check_out_time = VALUES(check_out_time), status = VALUES(status), tardy_reason = VALUES(tardy_reason), modify_reason = VALUES(modify_reason), overtime_hours = VALUES(overtime_hours), night_work_hours = VALUES(night_work_hours), holiday_work_hours = VALUES(holiday_work_hours), is_unpaid_leave = VALUES(is_unpaid_leave)
mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id as attendanceId, employee_id as employeeId, work_date as workDate, check_in_time as checkInTime, check_out_time as checkOutTime, status as status, tardy_reason as tardyReason, modify_reason as modifyReason, is_closed as closed, overtime_hours as overtimeHours, night_work_hours as nightWorkHours, holiday_work_hours as holidayWorkHours, is_unpaid_leave as unpaidLeave FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND work_date = #{workDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT attendance_id as attendanceId, employee_id as employeeId, work_date as workDate, check_in_time as checkInTime, check_out_time as checkOutTime, status as status, tardy_reason as tardyReason, modify_reason as modifyReason, is_closed as closed, overtime_hours as overtimeHours, night_work_hours as nightWorkHours, holiday_work_hours as holidayWorkHours, is_unpaid_leave as unpaidLeave FROM attendance_record WHERE ORDER BY work_date ASC, attendance_id ASC

SELECT attendance_id as attendanceId, employee_id as employeeId, work_date as workDate, check_in_time as checkInTime, check_out_time as checkOutTime, status as status, tardy_reason as tardyReason, modify_reason as modifyReason, is_closed as closed, overtime_hours as overtimeHours, night_work_hours as nightWorkHours, holiday_work_hours as holidayWorkHours, is_unpaid_leave as unpaidLeave FROM attendance_record WHERE work_date = #{workDate} AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND check_out_time IS NULL AND COALESCE(is_closed, FALSE) = FALSE

mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_record SET check_in_time = #{checkInTime}, check_out_time = #{checkOutTime}, status = #{status}, modify_reason = #{modifyReason} WHERE attendance_id = #{attendanceId} AND COALESCE(is_closed, FALSE) = FALSE

SELECT attendance_id as attendanceId, employee_id as employeeId, work_date as workDate, check_in_time as checkInTime, check_out_time as checkOutTime, status as status, tardy_reason as tardyReason, modify_reason as modifyReason, is_closed as closed, overtime_hours as overtimeHours, night_work_hours as nightWorkHours, holiday_work_hours as holidayWorkHours, is_unpaid_leave as unpaidLeave FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND work_date >= #{startDate} AND work_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY work_date ASC, attendance_id ASC

SELECT s.employeeId as employeeId, s.employeeName as employeeName, s.departmentName as departmentName, s.normalCount as normalCount, s.tardyCount as tardyCount, s.earlyLeaveCount as earlyLeaveCount, s.absentCount as absentCount, s.vacationCount as vacationCount, s.closedCount as closedCount, s.averageWorkHours as averageWorkHours, CASE WHEN COALESCE(lb.totalAnnualLeave, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(lr.approvedLeaveDays, 0) / lb.totalAnnualLeave * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as leaveUtilizationRate, COALESCE(w.maxWeeklyWorkHours, 0) as maxWeeklyWorkHours, CASE WHEN COALESCE(w.maxWeeklyWorkHours, 0) > 52 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as weekly52HourExceeded, CASE WHEN COALESCE(w.maxWeeklyWorkHours, 0) >= 48 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as weekly52HourWarning FROM ( SELECT ar.employee_id as employeeId, e.employee_name as employeeName, COALESCE(o.org_name, '미소속') as departmentName, COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'TARDY' THEN 1 END) as tardyCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'EARLY_LEAVE' THEN 1 END) as earlyLeaveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 END) as absentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.status IN ('VACATION', 'HALF_VACATION') THEN 1 END) as vacationCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ar.is_closed, FALSE) = TRUE THEN 1 END) as closedCount, ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN ar.check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND ar.check_out_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ar.check_in_time, ar.check_out_time) / 60.0 ELSE NULL END ), 2) as averageWorkHours FROM attendance_record ar JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = ar.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id WHERE ar.work_date >= CONCAT(#{targetMonth}, '-01') AND ar.work_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{targetMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY ar.employee_id, e.employee_name, o.org_name ) s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT employee_id, total_annual_leave as totalAnnualLeave FROM leave_balance WHERE base_year = #{baseYear} ) lb ON lb.employee_id = s.employeeId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT employee_id, COALESCE(SUM(used_days), 0) as approvedLeaveDays FROM leave_request WHERE leave_status = 'APPROVED' AND YEAR(start_date) = #{baseYear} GROUP BY employee_id ) lr ON lr.employee_id = s.employeeId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT weekly.employee_id as employeeId, MAX(weekly.weeklyHours) as maxWeeklyWorkHours FROM ( SELECT ar.employee_id, YEARWEEK(ar.work_date, 1) as weekKey, ROUND(SUM( CASE WHEN ar.check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND ar.check_out_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ar.check_in_time, ar.check_out_time) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END + COALESCE(ar.overtime_hours, 0) + COALESCE(ar.night_work_hours, 0) + COALESCE(ar.holiday_work_hours, 0) ), 2) as weeklyHours FROM attendance_record ar WHERE ar.work_date >= #{weekRangeStart} AND ar.work_date < #{weekRangeEnd} GROUP BY ar.employee_id, YEARWEEK(ar.work_date, 1) ) weekly GROUP BY weekly.employee_id ) w ON w.employeeId = s.employeeId ORDER BY s.absentCount DESC, s.tardyCount DESC, s.earlyLeaveCount DESC, s.employeeName ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT ar.employee_id FROM attendance_record ar WHERE ar.work_date >= CONCAT(#{targetMonth}, '-01') AND ar.work_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{targetMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY ar.employee_id ) t

SELECT #{employeeId} as employeeId, #{year} as year, #{month} as month, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as normalWorkDays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NORMAL' AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND check_out_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, check_in_time, check_out_time)/60.0 ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalNormalWorkHours, COALESCE(SUM(overtime_hours), 0) as totalOvertimeHours, COALESCE(SUM(night_work_hours), 0) as nightWorkHours, COALESCE(SUM(holiday_work_hours), 0) as holidayWorkHours, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'TARDY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tardyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EARLY_LEAVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as earlyLeaveCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as absentDays, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'BUSINESS_TRIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as businessTripDays, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'VACATION' AND is_unpaid_leave = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paidLeaveDays, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'VACATION' AND is_unpaid_leave = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unpaidLeaveDays FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND YEAR(work_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(work_date) = #{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_record SET status = 'EARLY_LEAVE', modify_reason = 'System Auto Closed' WHERE work_date = #{workDate} AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND check_out_time IS NULL
UPDATE attendance_record SET status = 'EARLY_LEAVE', modify_reason = 'Monthly Close Auto Closed' WHERE AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND check_out_time IS NULL AND COALESCE(is_closed, FALSE) = FALSE

UPDATE attendance_record SET is_closed = TRUE, modify_reason = CASE WHEN modify_reason IS NULL OR modify_reason = '' THEN 'Monthly Close Finalized' ELSE modify_reason END WHERE AND COALESCE(is_closed, FALSE) = FALSE

UPDATE attendance_record SET is_closed = FALSE, modify_reason = CASE WHEN modify_reason IS NULL OR modify_reason = '' THEN 'Monthly Reopen Finalized' ELSE CONCAT(modify_reason, ' | Monthly Reopen Finalized') END WHERE AND COALESCE(is_closed, FALSE) = TRUE
